function.name: ProductSearch_execute
function.description: Performs a search for products in the database based on specified criteria, such as keywords and filters, and returns a list of matching products. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

keywords.description: The search terms used to find products, separated by spaces.

category.description: The category to filter the search results. If no category is specified, all categories will be included in the search.

price_range.description: A price range to narrow down the search results, specified as a string in the format 'min-max' where min and max are prices in USD.

sort_order.description: The order in which the search results are sorted. Choose 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending order.

in_stock.description: A flag to filter search results to only include products that are in stock. Set to true to include only in-stock items.

message.content:
Cream is a versatile, neutral shade that can work well in many settings—especially if you’re aiming for a soft, understated look. Here are a few quick pointers to help you decide:

| Factor | Cream‑colored clothes work best when… | Why it matters |
|--------|--------------------------------------|----------------|
| **Skin tone** | Warm undertones (yellow, golden, olive) | Cream complements warm hues and adds a subtle glow. |
| | Cool undertones (pink, rosy, blue) | Cream can look slightly muted; pair with a pop of color or a contrasting accent. |
| **Occasion** | Casual or semi‑formal events | Cream gives a relaxed yet polished vibe. |
| | Formal or business settings | Pair with darker neutrals (navy, charcoal) or jewel tones for contrast. |
| **Season** | Spring/Summer | Light, airy feel. |
| | Fall/Winter | Works nicely with deeper colors; add texture (wool, tweed) for warmth. |
| **Personal style** | Minimalist or classic | Cream fits a clean aesthetic. |
| | Bold or eclectic | Use cream as a base and layer with bright accessories or patterned pieces. |

**Quick test:** Try holding a cream garment against your face in natural light. Does it brighten your complexion or make you look washed out? If it brightens, go for it! If it looks too pale, consider a slightly richer off‑white or a cream with a hint of beige.

If you’d like specific product suggestions (e.g., tops, dresses, or accessories in cream), let me know your preferred category, budget, and any style preferences, and I can pull up some options for you.
